description.zh: 把付费方式讲清楚的商业页面：页面通常以标题与计费周期切换开头，主体是并排的套餐卡 （价格、功能清单、行动按钮），推荐档位用视觉强调；下方补功能对比表和 FAQ 兜底疑虑。 组织逻辑是"先选周期、再选档位、最后消除犹豫"。
description.en: A commercial page that makes the offer legible: it opens with a headline and billing-period toggle, the body is a row of tier cards (price, feature list, action button) with the recommended tier visually emphasized, and a comparison table plus FAQ resolve remaining doubts. The order is fixed — pick a period, pick a tier, remove hesitation.

use_when.zh: 订阅制或有多个档位的产品售卖
访客需要在购买前比较不同方案
use_when.en: Visitors must compare plans before buying

use_when.zh: 需要引导用户从免费档向付费档升级
use_when.en: Guiding upgrades from free to paid tiers

avoid_when.zh: 只有一个固定价格（并入落地页即可）
avoid_when.en: One fixed price — fold it into the landing page

avoid_when.zh: 完全定制报价、按项目计费（用联系销售页更合适）
avoid_when.en: Fully custom quoting — a contact-sales page fits better

avoid_when.zh: 已登录用户的账户账单管理（属于设置/账单页）
avoid_when.en: Logged-in billing management — that belongs to settings

note.en: Three or four tier cards side by side, the classic

note.zh: 月付/年付切换并给出折扣提示
note.en: Monthly/annual toggle with a discount hint

note.zh: 套餐卡 + 完整功能对照表
note.en: Tier cards plus a full feature matrix

note.zh: 免费档永久免费，强调付费档价值
note.en: Free tier forever, paid tiers carry the pitch

anatomy: Billing Toggle 计费周期切换

note.zh: 页面主张与定位说明，先讲清价值再谈价格。
note.en: The page proposition and positioning before any numbers.

note.zh: 月付 / 年付切换，年付标注折扣。
note.en: Monthly/annual toggle with the annual discount surfaced.

note.zh: 2–4 档，推荐档视觉强化；每档列出关键差异。
note.en: Two to four tiers, one visually recommended, each listing key differences.

note.zh: 细粒度功能逐项对比，可折叠次要行。
note.en: Item-by-item feature comparison, with secondary rows collapsible.

note.zh: 打消计费、退款、升级等购买顾虑。
note.en: Addresses billing, refund and upgrade concerns.

notes.zh: 套餐卡用等高网格排布，推荐档位以边框强调色 + 轻微放大或徽标突出； 月/年切换用受控状态切换价格并做数字过渡；对比表桌面横向滚动、移动端折叠成手风琴； FAQ 用原生 details 或手风琴组件。
notes.en: Lay tier cards in an equal-height grid; emphasize the recommended tier with an accent border, slight scale or a badge. The billing toggle is controlled state that switches prices with a number transition. The comparison table scrolls horizontally on desktop and collapses into an accordion on mobile; FAQ uses native details or an accordion.

sources.name: Nielsen Norman Group — Pricing Page Design

basic.zh: 创建一个定价页，包含三档套餐卡、月付年付切换和功能对比表。
basic.en: Create a pricing page with three tier cards, a monthly/annual toggle and a feature comparison table.

design.zh: 创建 SaaS 定价页：标题 + 月付/年付分段切换（年付标"省 20%"）；三张等高套餐卡（免费/专业/企业），专业档用强调色边框 + "最受欢迎"徽标 + 轻微放大；每卡含价格、功能清单（勾选样式）、主按钮；下方功能对比表与 4 条 FAQ 手风琴。响应式，移动端卡片纵向堆叠。
design.en: Build a SaaS pricing page: headline + monthly/annual segmented toggle ("Save 20%" on annual); three equal-height tier cards (Free / Pro / Enterprise), Pro highlighted with an accent border, "Most popular" badge and slight scale; each card shows price, checklisted features and a primary button; below, a comparison table and a four-item FAQ accordion. Responsive — cards stack on mobile.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现定价页：billing 周期受控状态驱动价格渲染（带数字过渡）； 套餐卡数据驱动（{name, price, features, highlight}）；对比表用 table + 溢出滚动； FAQ 用受控手风琴；勾选图标内联 SVG。深浅色一致；不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind pricing page: billing period as controlled state driving price rendering (with a number transition); data-driven tier cards ({name, price, features, highlight}); comparison table with overflow scroll; controlled FAQ accordion; inline SVG checkmarks. Consistent light/dark; no new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现定价页。

先检查品牌色、现有卡片/手风琴组件与路由，保持一致。
要求：
- 月/年切换驱动价格与折扣角标
- 推荐档位视觉强调（边框 + 徽标）
- 功能对比表（移动端可横向滚动）
- FAQ 手风琴
- 深浅色一致，响应式
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the pricing page in the current project.

Inspect brand colors, existing card/accordion components and routes first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Monthly/annual toggle drives prices and discount badge
- Visual emphasis on the recommended tier (border + badge)
- Feature comparison table (horizontal scroll on mobile)
- FAQ accordion
- Consistent light/dark; responsive
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
